gh "pr" "create" "--base" "main" "--head" "feat/80-tool-presentation" "--title" "feat: let tools say how the workflow log shows their calls" "--body" "Refs #80. pit side: cv/pit#372.

A tool of a pi-durable extension can now have an optional `present` field, so that the code that knows the tool shows its calls, not pi-action. pi-durable is unchanged: pi-action reads the field as `unknown` and checks it (`src/tool-presentation.ts`).

- `present.call(args)` → `{ title, body? }`: the `🔧` line, and the details in place of the arguments.
- `present.result(args, result)` → `{ summary?, body? }`: the `↳` line in place of "N lines", and the details in place of the output.
- Each field left out gets the generic form. pi-action keeps its limits and stops workflow commands in the text.
- If a function throws, returns a promise, or returns the wrong types, pi-action falls back to the generic form and writes one `⚠️` line for each tool and hook.
- A tool that replaces an earlier one with the same name also replaces its `present`. The functions get copies of the arguments and the result.

The `// @pit:` parsing from #81 stays as the fallback until a pit release with `present` is pinned. Then it can go.

Docs: [Show tool calls in the workflow log](docs/extensions.md#show-tool-calls-in-the-workflow-log), and the `🔧` / `↳` rows in `docs/how-it-works.md`. `npm run check` passes."
